wu: Cafe Charades: Students mime actions (ordering, drinking, complaining) while others guess the phrase using 'Would you like...?' or 'I'd like...'.
wuAlt: Cafe Bingo: Students write 5 cafe items, teacher calls prompts (e.g., 'a cold drink'), students cross off if they have it.
Speed Dating Cafe: Students interview 3 peers about their favorite cafe drink using 'Can I have...?'
pres: Show 2 flashcards (correct vs. wrong order) and model polite phrases: 'I'd like a coffee, please' vs. 'Give me coffee'. Elicit the polite version. Check understanding with 'thumbs up/down' for polite/rude examples.
presAlt: Role-play a rude customer vs. a polite one, highlighting phrases. Use a cafe menu realia.
Read a short dialogue gap-fill on the board, students fill in polite requests.
prac: Polite Phrases Drill: Students stand in two lines, facing each other. Line A says 'Would you like...?' Line B replies 'I'd like...'. They rotate partners after 2 turns.
pracAlt: Cafe Menu Task: Pairs take turns ordering from a printed menu using target phrases.
Chain Story: Each student adds one polite sentence to a cafe story (e.g., 'I went to a cafe. I'd like...').
ls: Listen to a 2-minute dialogue of a customer politely complaining about cold coffee. Students circle the polite phrases ('I'm afraid', 'Would you mind...') on a worksheet.
re: Cafe Relay: Teams race to write polite complaints on the board (e.g., 'Would you mind heating my pizza?'). One runner per team, first correct wins.
prod: Cafe Complaint Roleplay: Pairs act as customer and waiter. Customer uses polite phrases to complain (e.g., 'I'm afraid my soup is cold'). Waiter apologizes and solves it. Switch roles.
rw: Read a short email complaint about a cafe. Underline all polite phrases. Then write a 60-word reply from the manager, apologizing politely.
st: Read a funny story 'The Polite Ghost at the Cafe'. End with the goodbye routine: 'Today we learned to order and complain politely in cafes. Thank you, class!'
g: Teams race to circle all polite phrases on a menu.
Students mime complaints for others to guess the phrase.
Teacher calls out rude phrases, students mark polite alternatives.
Students run to the board to write a polite order.
Pairs correct a rude cafe dialogue.
diff: Fast finishers: Write a 2-minute dialogue between a very polite customer and a confused waiter.
Support: Use sentence starters ('I'd like...', 'Would you mind...') on flashcards for reference.
hw: Write a 1-minute presentation about your dream cafe, using polite phrases.
Record yourself ordering a drink and complaining politely, send audio.
Design a cafe menu with 5 items and write 3 polite orders for it.
tip: Model Moroccan hospitality by emphasizing how polite phrases show respect—key in local culture. Pair strong/weak learners to boost confidence.
